fact: On 22 April 2025, for the seventh anniversary of its institutionalisation, the ANPDP held an open conversation with data processors in São Tomé, covering its inspections and a new approach in which authorisations are issued only once the processor complies with the law.
title: CONVERSA ABERTA COM OS TRATADORES DE DADOS PESSOAIS
publisher: ANPDP de São Tomé e Príncipe
